page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m4.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance powered by AMD EPYC processors running on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 4 dedicated x86_64 virtual CPU cores operating at a base frequency of 2.25 GHz alongside 16.0 GB of system memory. The configuration maintains a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The instance operates without integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for persistent disk storage and operating system installations. Hardware acceleration is absent, with zero GPUs provisioned. For networking, the instance offers a baseline throughput of 2 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, operating within private virtual networks by default.

From a resource and cost-efficiency perspective, the instance provides a balanced computing profile with dedicated AMD EPYC execution resources. The standard memory-to-core allocation provides predictable execution for tasks without incurring costs for unneeded hardware accelerators or high-capacity local drives. Tradeoffs include modest network baseline capacity and complete dependency on remote storage.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m4.xlarge is designed for general computing workloads. It fits multi-tier enterprise web servers, back-end API microservices, continuous integration pipelines, development environments, and small-to-midsize relational database or cache nodes that align with a balanced compute and memory footprint.
